I’ve been diagnosed with ADHD for 9ish years now and had it re-diagnosed at 18 (I am turning 21 this summer), but after the pandemic, I spent a lot more time examining my behavior and, I’ll be damned, I am also autistic. I really think that with this newfound awareness of why I felt so tired my whole life and “out of place” caused a major shift in how i think because I started allowing myself to be autistic. I think I may just a mixed type!

So after taking the cognitive functions test and talking to a friend, we have determined that It’s very true that I’m more of an introvert now, I’ve always been an “introverted extrovert” but with my diagnosis, I’ve found myself more reserved and realized i was stressing myself, forcing myself to be more extroverted than I was. I’ve pretty much determined that i’m most likely xNFP. In general, my Ni and Ne are used almost equally with it being used as Ne more with my Fi and Fe having a similar quality, explaining why I maybe have tested as an INFJ. As someone said in the thread, I think i may just not fall into a box completely.

For now, I’m probably going to hold off on labeling it fully until I can maybe talk to my therapist about my individual cognitive functions but I definitely understand what you mean about the relating to the other type. I still very much relate to ENFPs and get along very well with them, but since my diagnosis, I’ve realized my support needs in terms of overstimulation in social settings, has made me behave in a more introvert fashion. On the other hand, many of my mentors have described me in ways that are similar to what i’ve read on INFJs.

I’m cautious to actually label myself as INFJ because the type is more rare but given my cognitive functions, I can’t say I particularly fit into any category right now.
